title: AI Product Demo Video Generator | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into a clear demo that shows how the item works. Create videos for stores, product pages and paid social in 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.
h1: AI Product Video Generator: Show One Action From a Photo
lead: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo into a short demo of a single operation, such as a latch closing, a pour or a switch. No studio booking. Pick a size, choose 6 to 30 seconds and download a clip for a product page, a marketplace listing or a paid ad.

steps.d: Upload one clear photo with the full item and its moving part visible.

faq.q: What does a product demo video show?
faq.a: One useful operation from start to finish, such as a lid opening, a latch closing, a pour or a switch turning on.

faq.q: How is this different from image to video?
faq.a: Image to video adds motion to a still. A product demo is built around one operation a buyer would ask about.
One sharp photo with the full item and the moving part visible, in even light.
Opening, closing, pouring, packing, connecting, switching on and fitting, when the real product can do that action.

faq.q: Which sizes and lengths can I choose?
Will the demo match my product?
faq.a: Compare every result with the real item. If a color, button or moving part drifts, make another version instead of publishing it.

faq.q: Can I add the price and the product name?
faq.a: Yes. Add them after download in your editor so the generated scene stays clean.

faq.q: Can I use a product video for Shopify or an Etsy listing video?
faq.a: Yes. Place the download beside your listing photos or in an ad, and check that marketplace's rules first.

faq.q: How many credits does a product demo use?
faq.a: 24 for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. Failed jobs return the credits.

faq.q: Does the demo include a spoken explanation?
faq.a: No. The clip shows the action and does not write a spoken script. Record any spoken line in your editor if you need one.

faq.q: Is a person in the demo a real customer?
faq.a: No. Any person on screen is AI-generated. The demo shows the product action, not a buyer quote.

definition.title: What Is an AI Product Video Generator?
paras: An AI product video generator makes a short demo from your product photo. The clip shows one operation a shopper can follow, such as a lid opening, a drawer sliding or a kettle pouring.

Use it when a still photo leaves the action unclear. Review the finished demo beside the real item before you publish. Add the product name and price in your editor. The tool does not write a spoken script.
